area: Security gates: team-mode isolation of kept records, the four gates on the older writes and deletes, Client Connector OTP behind write mode, forced password change, ACME renewal while running, store encryption coverage
title: Wave 9: every write or delete route, old ones and the OTP reveal included, behind the write engine's gates; team mode keeps each tenant's records apart

checks.what: Team mode: a viewer of tenant A lists only A's configuration backups and the templates they may use; download, diff, delete, restore, clone and template apply of tenant B's backup_id or template_id are refused before sign-in
A kept configuration template is deleted only by the person who kept it (or an administrator); the operations picker hides another person's private template

/api/remediation/execute and /api/migrate/enable refuse a live run without, or with a stale, plan_hash with no tenant call; the Evaluate All enable makes one PUT, to the probed endpoint and field only

/api/dlp-packs/removal/apply(/start) needs DELETE <n> OBJECTS and /api/migrate/delete-all needs DELETE <n> RULES, checked on the server against the plan re-made from a fresh read; nothing is deleted otherwise
The Client Connector OTP reveal is refused with write mode off, before sign-in, with nothing audited as shown
An account an administrator creates or resets reaches only the password change (and who am I, sign-out) until its owner chooses a password
ACME: a certificate with 29 days left is renewed and loaded into the served TLS context; a failed renewal keeps the old certificate and is audited

With store encryption on, configuration backups, their index, templates, caches and sync jobs are sealed on disk, read back, re-sealed on key rotation; a sealed store without its key is an error, never an empty list

findings.title: In team mode configuration backups, templates, saved traffic reports, fleet history and tenant health were not bound to a tenant profile: a person of one tenant could list and restore another's
findings.fix: kept records name their tenant profile and maker; list filters and resolvers for backup_id, template_id and saved_name check entitlement; restore and clone check read on the source

findings.title: /api/remediation/execute and /api/migrate/enable wrote without a previewed plan hash, and the enable made blind PUT probes to guessed endpoints
findings.fix: a live run needs the dry run's plan_hash, re-plans and compares; the enable writes only the field its read-only probe found and reads it back

findings.title: Pack removal and delete-all deleted on confirm=true alone, without a typed phrase checked on the server
findings.fix: DELETE <n> OBJECTS and DELETE <n> RULES are required and checked against the re-made plan's count

findings.title: The Client Connector OTP reveal did not need write mode
findings.fix: refused with 403 before sign-in when write mode is off

findings.title: An account created or reset by an administrator kept the administrator's password
findings.fix: must_change_password: the middleware allows only the change route until the owner chooses a password; the Sign in page shows the form

findings.title: An ACME certificate was renewed only at start-up, so a server running past expiry served an expired certificate
findings.fix: a daily check renews below 30 days left and reloads the served TLS context, or says a restart is needed; a failure is audited

findings.title: Store encryption did not cover configuration backups, templates, caches and sync jobs, and a sealed index without its key read as empty (the next save replaced it)
findings.fix: sealed with store_crypto and listed in _store_paths; a sealed store without its key raises
